item.title: Bryan Norcross: The Atlantic rests while the Pacific keeps cranking out tropical systems
item.description: The atmospheric environment over the Caribbean and the tropical Atlantic continues to be hostile to any systems that are in a position to develop. Disturbances are moving off Africa on schedule, but the dust and dry air plus the El Niño-driven upper-level winds are prohibiting the systems from getting any traction.
